walk_60s.signals: kept cycling: the hold at the end of the pedestrian phase was 6 cast members still walking 6-40 m from the player (the normal clear-out), then PEDESTRIAN -> NS

fps.verdict: walking in the crowd is not slower than standing in it: the contact cost is within noise at ~150 ms frames. The PC runs HIGH at 6-7 fps in player mode, with or without this change.
